_readme: Edit badge names/descriptions freely — the server reads this at startup. wordTiers award by total words written (min). usage badges award ONCE the first time a committed story line contains one of the trigger words/phrases (case-insensitive, whole words; a trailing ? or ! in a trigger is required literally). Keep ids stable — they're stored on user accounts.

wordTiers.name: 🔫 There. Out Loud.
wordTiers.desc: Made an account. Said it — there, out loud.

usage.desc: Write “puppy” into a story line. Good boy.
